free_tier.stated: Snippets are git repositories that count toward the namespace storage size. No limit exists on how many snippets you can create. The default maximum size for a snippet is 50 MB, and a snippet repository is limited to 10 files.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: The default maximum size for a snippet is 50 MB. A snippet repository is limited to 10 files.
per_object_cap.notes: The snippets page gives the default maximum snippet size as current as of 2024-04-17, and links the administration page for the setting.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: Snippets use version control: each snippet has its own underlying repository, and each saved change records a new commit. No expiry period is stated on the page.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or volume quota is stated on the pages read. Public snippets can be cloned, and their raw content can be downloaded.

tooling: Snippets API (POST /snippets), git clone of the snippet repo, glab CLI, VS Code extension. Rate limited to 300 creates/hour/authenticated user.
chaining: No limits exist as to how many snippets you can create. Versioned snippets are considered part of the namespace storage size, so snippets are not a separate storage pool.
limits_note: Creating snippets is limited to 300 requests every hour for each authenticated user, shared with creating a project snippet and the createSnippet GraphQL mutation.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Snippets are visible/searchable by other users when public; storage is accounted at namespace level so it is the most likely subject to be capped first if GitLab ever enforces namespace quotas.

extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: No documented per-snippet storage cap; snippets are git-backed and unlimited in count, but contribute to namespace storage accounting
extras.limits_verbatim: 300 creations/hour/user, shared with the GraphQL createSnippet mutation. No documented file or snippet size cap found on the snippet docs page. Worth treating as 'unbounded but undocumented' rather than verified bulk capacity.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free, Cloudflare-fronted like all of GitLab.com; snippets are cloneable and downloadable via API.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Snippets are versioned git repos -> unlimited snippets x unlimited versions. The 300/hour creation limit is the only throttle, which is trivially high for a bulk loader. Storage counts toward namespace storage but is NOT enforced.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Snippets API (POST /snippets), git clone of the snippet repo, glab CLI, VS Code extension. Rate limited to 300 creates/hour/authenticated user.
extras.agent_focus: GitLab and the Forgejo/Gitea federation: container registry, package registry, generic packages, releases, snippets, Pages; Codeberg, Gitea hosted instances, SourceHut, Bitbucket, Radicle
